name: 2.9.2 - Wholesale Notes fix
notes: Wholesale Notes fix: the dry run no longer stops when the customer's Notes come up right after a Point-of-sale Memo (a window COSTAR is still making is looked at again for up to 5 s), and "no card details" comes only from a whole, settled read of the Notes. Nothing is typed, sold or changed. Update the RDP helper and the desk PC.
